description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Kitchen Finks
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters, it and Stalwart Successor trigger.
Resolve the Kitchen Finks trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Stalwart Successor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
